notes: Application code is self-contained within the 0x0-0x12000 payload.
Hardware/BLE-stack entry points referenced from startup live in a resident region above the downloadable image; the server image is the updatable application/runtime slot only.
gp-relative addressing (gp=0x1fffc000) is used for the BLE state block, including the 256-byte shortcut table at gp+0x80.
